title: client: after connecting a bank account, redirect to /connect-bank
description: After the user finishes connecting an account (the bank-connect flow in client/src/features/banks: ConnectBankWidget / ConnectBankScreen and any follow-on linking step such as linked-account or connection), the app must send them to the Connect Bank page, i.e. https://budget.syscd.live/connect-bank in production. That is the existing route client/src/app/(budget)/connect-bank.tsx. Today the flow ends somewhere else (or stays put); find where and change it.
notes:
Before: new-bank success (useConnectFlow.ts onWidgetMessage register -> landOnAccounts) did router.replace('/accounts'). Re-auth success (refresh) calls finish() and stays on /connect-bank (unchanged). Close/cancel button also used landOnAccounts -> /accounts (unchanged). After: register success replaces to /connect-bank via pure stepSuccessRoute (connectBank.logic.ts, tested); landOnAccounts kept for Close.
Validator: PASS. tsc/eslint/bun test (1072) green. Only new-bank register success now replaces to /connect-bank; refresh/close/error unchanged. Not verified in a running app.
Approved by Yuri. Validator PASS: a newly registered bank now router.replace's to /connect-bank instead of /accounts (useConnectFlow.ts, stepSuccessRoute in connectBank.logic.ts with tests); cancel, close, error and re-auth paths unchanged; no hardcoded production URL. Landed on local main as dfed478 (fast-forward, not pushed). tsc, eslint, bun test (1072 pass, 0 fail) green on merged main. No real widget connection run on web or iOS.
acceptance_criteria: 1) On a successful account connection the app navigates to the /connect-bank route (https://budget.syscd.live/connect-bank in production), on web and iOS. 2) Navigation uses the app router with the route path, not a hardcoded absolute production URL, so dev and e2e origins still work. 3) Cancelled or failed connections keep their current behaviour. 4) The redirect decision lives in a pure function or thin hook with a *.test.ts covering success vs cancel/error, where the existing structure allows it. 5) A tk note records where the flow landed before the change. 6) bunx tsc --noEmit, bunx eslint ., bun test pass in client/.

commits.subject: banks: a registered bank lands on /connect-bank instead of /accounts
